end_behaviour.condition: Reference advanced curve inspected on 1/12Y-1Y and 20Y-30Y dense grids.
end_behaviour.interpretation: Exposes endpoint ranges separately so an acceptable average cannot hide short- or long-end instability.

liquidity_weighting.condition: All fit weights set to one and the advanced model refit; curve compared with the weighted advanced fit.
liquidity_weighting.interpretation: Quantifies the effect of spread/liquidity weighting without attributing the difference to hidden truth accuracy.

outlier_threshold.condition: Advanced model refit at Huber thresholds 2.0, 3.0, and 4.0; all other settings fixed.
outlier_threshold.interpretation: Separates robustness-threshold sensitivity from maturity aggregation and interpolation choices.

remove_10_percent.condition: Deterministic 10% observation removal followed by an advanced-model refit.
remove_10_percent.interpretation: Measures observation-removal stability relative to the full advanced fit; it is not a truth-error metric.

smoothing_parameter.condition: Advanced model refit at smoothing_lambda 0.2, 2.0, and 20.0; same observations and pricing conventions.
smoothing_parameter.interpretation: Reports fit error and maximum zero-curve displacement; large displacement indicates smoothing sensitivity, not proof that one setting is true.
